inspect: A hammock from the night of the condemning, still slung. Yellow at the edges. It goes grrr when the ship rolls.
Hammock rings and a bare frame. Nothing to sleep in. Everything that was on it is in the locker, growling.
A hammock of Cheap-O-Rama toy sashes, doubled and laced to the old rings. Red. Crackly. AGES SIX AND UP along the edge. Very comfortable. You hate that.
A cot with yellow sheets, stiff as a board. It whimpers.
A bare cot frame. Webbing and rope.

A cot with a sash-box mattress pad in a sleeve of sashes, a folded-sash pillow with a little embroidered nose on it, and a red sash blanket. GRAND STENCHMASTER CEREMONIAL SASH PLAYSET, says the pillow.
Garrick's grand hammock, remade in sashes, gold side out. A GRAND NAP pillowcase. It's the nicest bed on the ship and it's his.
Every sheet, blanket, pillow, pillowcase, mattress cover and scrap of hammock cloth in the quarters, in a heap. Growling, all together, quietly.
The Mega-Pack box, open. Packing straw, a few more foam dice, a spare HOLD MY SASH flag, and the instructions for the cardboard (FOLD ALONG DOTTED LINE. DO NOT BEND BROGATH).
Pennants on a string: GRAND STENCHMASTER. GRAND STENCHMASTER. GRAND STENCHMASTER.
Merchandise: a mug (WORLD'S GRANDEST), foam dice, a saucepan-lid medal, a Bean Bailiff badge, a Grand Court sticker. A Grand Finger-Puller certification card, blank.
A little shelf: a candle stub, a book called KNOTS, and (behind it, where nobody will ever look) a can of Spicy Stench Sauce.
Three turns of Garrick's television cable round the starboard cannon. 'For grounding.' If anyone fires it now, the bedroom set goes with the ball.
